description: Search the AINumbers catalog (480+ client-side fintech tools). Returns deep-links; prefill-enabled tools accept #in=<base64url(JSON of {element_id: value})>[&run=1] for one-click invocation.

category.description: Restrict results to one catalog category (e.g. "mortgage", "kyc"). Omit for all categories.

cursor.description: Page token: echo the nextCursor from the previous reply to fetch the next page (keyset on tool name — stable across catalog regens).

query.description: Free-text search over tool name and description. Omit to list without filtering.
